answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent earns full rewards only after trading with 20 counterparties over a horizon of 30 epochs. Each must be a pearl of history, with 10 settled trades, not a fresh shell. A sybil ring of 1,000 fakes costs 25,000 POA in bonds plus weeks to age each fake, while an honest agent pays one 25 POA bond. Ivory-tower fakes trading only among themselves never reach the threshold, so honest rewards stay undiluted.
